project.name: kinotch-repo-monitor
project.description: Localhost Web UI for cached local Git repository activity, read-only devflow workflow state, and direct ChatGPT/repository navigation.

notes: Uses a loopback-only local HTTP server and responsive Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS UI.
Local activity state is derived only from local Git/filesystem observation.
v0.5 serves browser state from a cached complete snapshot; one background scan engine owns Git scan generations with an 8-worker bound.
Public devflow Repository Control Issues are read as a separate cached workflow-state overlay; this is not direct ChatGPT execution-state detection.
RDC is not required for build, verification, or operation.
